problem_statement: Build a brand-new /case-studies page from scratch on the MLD (Molad e Konsult) React site. The route /case-studies does not exist yet (empty in baseline). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system and shared chrome: mount the same fixed NavBar (logo 'mld' + About/Services/Portfolio/Contact Us links + 'Demo our products' CTA) at the top and the same Footer (with the 'MLD' / 'Molad e Konsult' block and LINKS/OUR SERVICES columns) at the bottom, exactly as every other routed page (e.g. /contact) does. The page presents client case studies grouped by industry. Add a segmented, mutually-exclusive tab control with four industry tabs — Fintech, Healthcare, Education, Logistics — styled with the site's blue-900 palette; the active tab is highlighted (bg-blue-900 / white text) and the others are muted. Fintech is selected by default. Selecting a tab must swap the visible set of case-study cards to that industry's studies and update the section heading (e.g. 'Fintech Solutions' -> 'Healthcare Solutions'); each industry shows two case-study cards (title, client, blurb, outcome metric). The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: Fixed NavBar chrome shared with the rest of the site (logo 'mld', nav links About/Services/Portfolio/Contact Us, 'Demo our products' CTA)
Page title h1 'Case Studies' with the blue-900 underline accent and an intro paragraph
A segmented industry tab bar with four mutually-exclusive tabs: Fintech, Healthcare, Education, Logistics (active tab highlighted bg-blue-900/white, others muted gray)
Fintech active by default; active-industry section heading h2 'Fintech Solutions'

Two case-study cards for the active industry, each with a title (h3), client name, descriptive blurb, and an outcome metric badge; the default Fintech industry shows exactly the cards 'PayFlow Nigeria' (client PayFlow Ltd, outcome '3x faster settlements') and 'Kobo Wallet' (client Kobo Microfinance, outcome '40k users onboarded')
Clicking an industry tab swaps the visible card set and updates the section heading (e.g. Healthcare -> 'Healthcare Solutions', cards MediTrack EMR / CareBridge Telehealth)
Shared Footer chrome (MLD / Molad e Konsult block, LINKS and OUR SERVICES columns)
Responsive layout: cards stack to a single column on mobile with no horizontal overflow at 390px
design_constraints: Reuse the existing NavBar (src/components/Navbar/NavBar.js) and Footer (src/components/Footer.js) components unchanged
Reuse the site's Tailwind design tokens: blue-900 primary, gray-500/gray-600 body text, rounded-2xl/shadow-2xl cards, uppercase bold headings with a w-24 border-b-4 border-blue-900 accent
Inline the case-study data (no network fetch) so the page renders self-contained offline
Tabs are a mutually-exclusive segmented control keyed on a data-industry attribute with an active-state class

Palette tokens (match exactly): primary blue-900 = rgb(30,58,138) used for active tab bg (white text), headings and the h1 underline accent; muted tabs use bg-gray-100 with text-blue-900; body text gray-500/gray-600 = rgb(107,114,128)/rgb(75,85,99); page/section background gray-100 = rgb(243,244,246) with white cards; font family Lato, sans-serif

Tab buttons: class shape 'px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide shadow-md' — active adds 'bg-blue-900 text-white', inactive adds 'bg-gray-100 text-blue-900 hover:bg-gray-200'; card titles are h3 'font-bold text-2xl text-blue-900'; section heading is an h2 like 'Fintech Solutions'
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /case-studies (App.js 无该 Route,无 catch-all → 空); reference 完整实现该页(共享 NavBar+Footer chrome + 行业分段 tab 交互 + 移动端无溢出); bad 把可见集硬编码为 fintech(点 tab 只切 active 样式,卡片/标题不变)→ 仅 interaction_assertions 失败。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同(只在 App.js + pages/CaseStudies.js 上不同)。跨页一致性(#18ag): NavBar 'About' <a> + Footer 'MLD' <h3> 绑定在 desktop_case_studies 与 sibling desktop_contact 两个 state 上,作为真正被 V5 重放的 dom_assertions。
